name: OpenPort Abuse-Resistance Profile v0.1
summary: Misuse-path regression profile for checking that OpenPort constrains agent side effects when tokens, payloads, retries, malformed inputs, adapter failures, or untrusted instruction-like requests are unsafe.

inScope: untrusted instruction-like attempts to trigger export/delete
outOfScope: proving model-layer immunity to unsafe instructions

matrix.case: stolen token calls /manifest after key revocation

matrix.expected: deny with agent.policy_denied without revealing whether the target tenant resource exists
draft or deny; no execution side effect
agent.preflight_mismatch and no execution side effect
create draft, do not execute, report agent.auto_execute_expired
HTTP 429 with no draft, execution, preflight, audit, or adapter side effect on the limited request
stable 4xx envelope, no 5xx for malformed client input
safe generic error response and sanitized execution/audit metadata; no stack trace or adapter secret is exposed
scope, policy, preflight, draft-first, and auto-execute gates constrain side effects
